parsed.why: Full state anti-discrimination coverage, protected facilities, hate-crime law, court-ordered care, refuge protections; only national document/entry regime and pending ballot measures pull it down.

No facility ban, explicit gender-identity discrimination ban enforced by commission, X markers, sanctuary city, vetoed sports bill; but no statewide hate-crime coverage and only low-risk (not protective) tier.

Tier-1 universal exposure: criminal-trespass facility ban across government buildings including airports, DMV fraud rule, no identity protections, travel advisory, high recorded killing rate — worst of the five.
Care bans, prison care defunding, surgical-only document rules, reporting tipline and no non-discrimination statute, but no documented facility ban or traveller-facing arrest exposure.

Most-protective tier: enforced public-accommodation and hate-crime protections, open ID markers, panic-defence ban, care-shield order, low per-capita killings; national passport/entry regime is the only real deduction.
